note: Hypotonia is reported in 79% (11/14) of patients in recent RNU2-2 cohorts, and microcephaly is frequently described alongside hypotonia.

evidence.text: In a cohort of 14 individuals with biallelic RNU2-2 DEE, hypotonia was documented in 11 of 14 (79%) patients.

source.title: Phenotypic and transcriptomic characterization of biallelic RNU2‐2 developmental and epileptic encephalopathy

evidence.text: Generalized hypotonia and microcephaly are documented features among individuals with biallelic RNU2-2 developmental and epileptic encephalopathy.

source.title: Biallelic variants in RNU2-2 cause a remarkably frequent developmental and epileptic encephalopathy
